overview: Docket (1941-44) on Japanese marine shipbuilding: merchant-ship program, the halted Kasuga Maru, wartime wooden-vessel output, Hong Kong yards, Dairen tankers, and Mitsubishi freighter orders.

subfiles.title: Department of State list of papers on Japanese marine engineering and shipbuilding
subfiles.about: An index to papers concerning Japan’s shipbuilding industry, merchant-vessel program, and wartime shipping measures.
subfiles.summary: Docket (1941-44) lists reports on the halted Kasuga Maru, wooden-ship output in Hong Kong and Japan, Dairen tanker construction, and seven Mitsubishi freighters.

interest: Shows wartime US intelligence tracking of Japanese shipbuilding via diplomatic, press, and captured sources, 1941-44.
